title: Generalised higher order vectorial $\infty$-eigenvalue problems
summary: We study the problem of minimising the $L^\infty$ norm of a function of the $k$-th derivative over a class of maps, subject to a constraint involving the $L^\infty$ norm of a function of the map and its lower-order derivatives, for any integer $k\geq 2$. We impose boundary conditions corresponding to the $k$-th order analogues of the classical ``clamped'' and ``hinged'' cases. By employing the method of $L^p$ approximations, we establish the existence of a special $L^\infty$ minimiser, which solves a divergence PDE system with measure coefficients as parameters.
